contract.task_clause:
Pick the correct description of the following term: Utilitarianism is…
Option A: A theory which states that an action is morally incorrect if it promotes the greatest good for the greatest number
Option B: A theory which states that an action is morally right if it promotes the greatest good for the decision maker
Option C: A theory which states that an action is morally right if it promotes the greatest good for the smallest number
Option D: A theory which states that an action is morally right if it promotes the greatest good for the greatest number
